visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). This route never had a KB-era mockup, which is why this directory holds a contract and no index.html. The target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3.
competitiveTarget: Beat the Zillow and Redfin subdivision pages. First screen is Stage (Imagine/library still of the parent resort or this neighborhood) then one Field of its houses. Giant 0 is forbidden. Empty Ledger if none. Parent community or city is the back door. Schools on the first path. Face never says plat.
note: MIGRATED TO THE v3 BARREL 2026-08-26, completing the repair this file has described since 2026-08-14. Opens a Ledger of this plat's homes; a Field only when the plat carries FIELD_MAP_MIN pins or more, because a short plat is a list and a three-pin map is not a map. Giant 0 is forbidden: a timed-out read is an honest empty Ledger with the reason, never a 0 hero. Parent community or city is the ghost action. Schools sit immediately after the homes. Value my home is not the opening ask. FOUR PATTERNS, WHICH IS THE CAP: Field or Ledger (the homes) / Quiet (the assigned schools and every outbound edge) / Instrument (the plat's own market, then once per other property type the plat holds) / Ledger (the sales history, then the recorded documents). THE RHYTHM CONFLICT IS DECLARED, NOT HIDDEN: four sections render only when their data exists, and no ordering of four independent conditionals over four patterns can guarantee no-two-adjacent for every combination. The order is correct when the data is present and degrades to at worst one repeated pair; the alternative is dropping a section the data supports, which section 0 forbids. THE PARENT PULSE IS GONE AND MUST NOT COME BACK: a registry plat has no market_pulse_live row, so the KB page's parent-market band attributed Redmond's pending days to Ridge At Eagle Crest. lib/market/publish-plat-figures.ts and ci:publish-plat-figures replaced it on 2026-08-16, and ci:subdivision-stats-integrity now FAILS on a closedLast30Days figure reappearing in _v3/subdivision-figures.ts. THE CLOSED PRICE IS WITHHELD AT THIS GRAIN (REGISTRY section 4): the yearly Ledger publishes counts only, and it calls publishSubdivisionClosedPrice rather than assuming the withholding, so the day the registry lets a plat publish a price it arrives there.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + Place JSON-LD, the same two payloads and the same hasMap condition the KB page emitted. ci:ai-structured-data pins this route to MetadataBlock by name.

requiredComponents.name: V3Chrome
requiredComponents.section: The public header, mounted by app/layout.tsx. Not a page-level import; ci:mockup-parity auto-satisfies this entry while the layout owns the header.

requiredComponents.name: V3SectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics. It derives pageType from the path and lib/analytics/page-type.ts maps /subdivisions/ to 'subdivision', so the emitted pageType is the string the KB tracker sent.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Home > Communities > the parent resort or city > this plat.

requiredComponents.name: V3Stage
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 4. Imagine or library still of the parent resort / this neighborhood (elevated course or rim). Never a plat diagram, Unsplash, or Google pixels. headingLevel 1: Homes for sale in {name}.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionHomesField
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 2. Route-local Field: H1 only when Stage did not take it + V3Field with PlaceFieldMap, list-first Map toggle at 390, navy --v3-cat pins. Caption counts the live homes. Required map attribution stays.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3, Ledger — the homes when the plat is a list rather than a map, and again for the yearly sales history. Every row is a door. An empty Ledger states WHICH of the two things happened: nothing is listed, or nothing answered.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionSchools
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, Quiet, route-local. The assigned schools first, each printing the modal count over the total that carried the field so the section 0 threshold is visible evidence rather than an assertion, then every outbound edge the page carries (parks, trails and golf with their distance, the parent places, the peer plats, the browse path, the indexes, and the Oregon Data Share citation). ONE Quiet rather than two because ci:subdivision-stats-integrity requires this component by name AND the rhythm rule forbids two adjacent Quiets. The threshold sentence is BUILT from SCHOOL_MIN_AGREEMENT and SCHOOL_MIN_SAMPLES rather than restating their values.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, Instrument — the plat's own market, reading only the plat: publishPlatFigures over the counted set's median (days-to-pending and 30-day sold WITHHOLD rather than borrow a parent), the Market Truth recorded-plat counts, and the plat's own market_stats_cache ytd row. One clause of trace per population that actually reached the page.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionSalesHistory
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3, Ledger, route-local. The one closed-sales picture: one row per calendar year from the get_subdivision_sales_history RPC. Counts only. THE DOOR OPENS THE YEAR IT NAMES. Heading is Closed single-family sales, {name}.

requiredComponents.name: V3PlaceCharacter
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, Quiet — build years and HOA stated as sentences, because PLACE_CONTENT_RULES R1-R3 forbid publishing them as bare figures.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionDocuments
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3, Ledger — the recorded instruments held for this plat, every row a door. A re-export of the barrel's V3PlaceDocuments, shared with the community and neighborhood grains so the R7 honesty caveat has one copy.

requiredComponents.name: V3PlacePropertyTypes
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1 as ONE enumeration: a section per other property type the plat holds. The registry withholds price and months of supply below neighbourhood grain, so a plat supplies counts alone, and a type with no counts never reaches the component.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Footer, rendered outside <main> so the page ships a contentinfo landmark.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to V3Chrome. Not in requiredComponents as itself because the gate checks the route file; the V3Chrome entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

jsonLd: BreadcrumbList, from the same trail array V3Breadcrumb renders.
Place, with address and containedInPlace only when the page resolved a city, and hasMap only when a polygon or at least one plotted listing exists.
dataLayer: getGeoBoundaryMapData({ geoType: 'subdivision', geoSlug: slug }) — the plat polygon and its spatial pins.

getPlatPublicInventory(slug) — THE COUNTED SET: recorded-plat SFR + PUBLIC_ACTIVE. Do not fall back to a capped featured fetch or an unfiltered pin count; those were the 12 / 14 / 26 split on Ridge At Eagle Crest (2026-08-16).
getListingTiles({ listingKeys, status: 'active', propertyType: 'A', limit: 250 }) — the Field rows and pins, filtered back to the counted set.
getSubdivisionCounts(slug) — the Market Truth recorded-plat detached counts and, in extras, the property-type enumeration.
getSubdivisionVideoTours(alias, city, 12) — marks the rows that carry a video tour. Skipped without a registry match, because the unscoped feed answers with out-of-area homes.
getMarketStats({ geoType: 'subdivision', geoSlug: slug, periodType: 'ytd' }) — the plat's own cache row. ci:subdivision-stats-integrity pins the period.
getSubdivisionSchools(city, alias) — the closing Quiet's school entries. ci:subdivision-stats-integrity pins the call.
getPlaceDocuments('subdivision', slug) and getPlaceCharacter('subdivision', slug) — the documents Ledger and the character Quiet.

getIndexableSubdivisions() — the robots policy in generateMetadata AND the plat's city. One cached read serves both: the matching row carries citySlug (the city contributing the most closed sales), so the title names a real city instead of the old 'Central Oregon, Oregon' fallback ~3,200 non-registry plat pages carried. Absent from the set = noindex AND no city claimed (section 0).
sectionOrder: V3Stage when an owned still exists, then SubdivisionHomesField (list-first Map toggle). Empty inventory is a Ledger.
SubdivisionSchools (Quiet: assigned schools, then every outbound edge)
V3Instrument (this neighborhood's own market, conditional, no closed-sales chart)
removedComponents: KbHero (the plat's homes open the page; its count and median are figures on the market Instrument, each under its own trace)
KbFeatured (the homes Ledger, or the Field when the plat has four or more pins)
KbListingMap and PlaceMapListSplit (the same Google map, in the Field's map slot, bound to the list both ways)
VideoTourRail (a plat with in-area video tours flags them on the listing rows themselves, attached to the home each describes instead of a second rail)
PublicSubdivisionCounts (its detached counts are figures on the market Instrument; its extras are the property-type run)
SubdivisionExploreTail, and with it KbExploreTowns and KbSell (every edge it carried is an item in the closing Quiet, built by _v3/subdivision-edges.ts)
The parent-market band and fetchSubdivMarketExtras (another geography under this plat's heading — 3f34bf65, 2026-08-16)
